canonical_name: Insider Threat Awareness Training Not Provided
description: Personnel do not receive training on recognizing and reporting potential insider threat indicators. This signal indicates that employees may not understand how to identify suspicious behavior from colleagues or themselves.
applicability: Applicable to all organizations handling CUI. Includes insider threat awareness programs, behavioral indicator training, and reporting procedure education.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through insider threat training program review, training content assessment, and completion records verification.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - Awareness and Training
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
